pages.text: Radiocraft brings $(thing)amateur radio$() to Minecraft. You talk through the radios with your real voice using $(thing)Simple Voice Chat$(), which must be installed on the server and your client.$(br2)Radios hear each other only on the same frequency and band, and how far they reach depends on the antenna, the band, the time of day and the sun.

Two families of radio:$(li)$(thing)VHF$() (2 m band, 144-148 MHz): handhelds and base stations. Short range, line of sight, no static. Easy to start with.$(li)$(thing)HF$() (80, 40, 20 and 10 m): long range by bouncing off the sky ("skip"), but they need a real antenna, power and some care.
pages.title: Two kinds of radio

pages.text: Every licensed operator has a $(thing)call sign$(). Use $(thing)/callsign$() to see or set yours. Digital modes and repeaters send it so others know who they heard.$(br2)New here? Read $(l:radiocraft:getting_started/first_station)Your First Station$(/l).
pages.title: Call signs
